title: Did you know… Isaac willingly laid on the altar without recorded resistance?
paragraphs: Did you know… Isaac willingly laid on the altar without recorded resistance?
Most of us picture Genesis 22 like a horror scene—an old father, trembling, forcing his son onto the altar.
But the text never says that.

No struggle recorded.
No resistance written.
Some scholars interpret he was a young man—strong enough to carry the wood… strong enough to overpower his aging father.
The son trusted the father… even when the fire was lit and the knife was raised.
“But where is the lamb?” Isaac asked.
And heaven stayed quiet… for a moment.
Because centuries later, another Son would carry wood on His back—up a hill called Golgotha.
And this time, the Father wouldn’t stop the knife.

Your sin.
My rebellion.
Our wandering hearts.
And where Isaac asked, “Where is the lamb?”…
So the question isn’t just about Isaac anymore.
Will you trust the Father… even when you don’t understand?
Will you lay down your will… your plans… your control?
Or will you keep fighting the One who gave everything for you?
Receive the grace already paid for in full.
Jesus didn’t resist the cross—so you wouldn’t have to carry your sin alone.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
